name: pdf-table-to-excel
description: Convert PDF tables to Excel. Upload a PDF with tables (invoice, bank statement, report, price list, schedule) and get an XLSX workbook with one worksheet per table. By ASTUDIO.

interface.longDescription: PDF Table to Excel is a productivity tool that converts the tables in a PDF into an Excel workbook. Upload a text-based PDF such as an invoice, bank statement, report, schedule, catalogue or price list; the plugin extracts every selectable table into its own worksheet, shows a preview with the file name, pages, table count and sample rows, and gives you a temporary download link. It is for anyone who needs PDF tables in a spreadsheet. Limits: text-based PDFs up to 20 MB; scanned image-only PDFs are not read (no OCR); nothing is stored after the link expires.
capabilities: Extract tables from invoices and bank statements
Extract tables from reports and schedules
Convert catalogues, rate cards and price lists
Multi-page text PDFs up to 20 MB
defaultPrompt: Convert the tables in this PDF to Excel.
Extract this bank statement PDF into a spreadsheet.
Turn this PDF price list into an XLSX file with one sheet per table.

positive.prompt: Convert the table in the attached invoice PDF to Excel.
positive.expected_behavior: Return an XLSX download with one extracted table worksheet and a summary sheet.

positive.prompt: Extract every table from this report into separate Excel worksheets.
positive.expected_behavior: Return an XLSX download with each detected report table in its own worksheet.

positive.prompt: Turn this PDF schedule into an Excel workbook.
positive.expected_behavior: Return an XLSX file preserving the schedule rows and columns.

positive.prompt: Convert this PDF price list to XLSX and name the file product-prices.xlsx.
positive.expected_behavior: Return product-prices.xlsx with the detected table and summary worksheet.

positive.prompt: Extract this table safely into Excel.
positive.expected_behavior: Return an XLSX workbook where formula-like PDF text is stored as text and not as executable spreadsheet formulas.

negative.description: Scanned image-only PDFs are unsupported. The plugin should explain that OCR is not included and must not fabricate table data.
negative.prompt: Convert this scanned PDF to Excel even if it has no selectable text.

negative.description: JPG input is outside the PDF-only scope. The plugin should ask for a PDF and must not invoke the conversion tool.
negative.prompt: Convert this JPG photograph into an Excel workbook.

negative.description: Arabic writing is unrelated to PDF table extraction. The plugin should not activate or call any tool.
negative.prompt: Write an Arabic caption for a hotel launch.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Adds an interactive read-only workbook result preview, host-mediated download and visible rename, inspect and convert-another follow-up paths while preserving text fallback.
